summary: Commit-bound visual evidence supports acceptance. Six same-framing stage panels expose raw images, both probability heads, filled masks, instance boundaries, measured centerlines, and final overlays. Two stratified tracking figures provide unobscured raw context and consecutive-plane overlays for short tracks plus faint, bright, long, wide, curved, touching, and irregular cases. The short examples remain present and measurable, use stable target colors across observed planes, and are not presented as a second accepted population. No material clipping, identity switch, geometry-obscuring annotation, or obvious systematic segmentation failure was found. Confidence is medium because the evidence covers only two specimens and cannot visually distinguish every genuine short nucleus from every unresolved fragment.

findings.title: Visual evidence cannot classify every very short target biologically
findings.impact: A below-2-um target can visually resemble a genuine optical tip, a fragment, or noise; the figures demonstrate retention and measurability but cannot establish the biological origin of every short track.
evidence: In audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/WT-01_stratified_tracking.png, the short target is a very small single-plane object at z066.
In audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png, the short target is visible on only z034-z035.
The claim snapshot lists the known limitation that length alone cannot distinguish a genuine short nucleus from an unresolved fragment.
findings.recommendation: Retain the stated limitation and continue treating below-2-um omission strictly as specimen-level sensitivity analysis, not as a visual rejection rule or separate accepted population.

limitations: The retained visual sample covers two specimens and selected planes rather than the full image stacks, as required by the review scope.
No independent pixel-level ground-truth annotations were provided, so subtle missed detections, small boundary errors, and ambiguous fragment identities cannot be quantified from these figures.
The WT short example is single-slice; cross-plane identity consistency is therefore directly testable only for the KJ short example.
The stage artifacts were generated at commit 6f9e73b170db121460ab82f28542d1ed1e8f96bb and reviewed through the retained blob-hash binding rather than regenerated at the reviewed audit-only commit.
recommended_follow_up: Preserve the unobscured raw-first tracking layout and deterministic category manifest in future acceptance candidates.
If additional specimens become available, add non-extremal below-2-um examples spanning isolated optical tips and crowded or touching contexts without creating a routine manual-review queue.
